FROM [Manga] AS [m]

    FROM [ViewCount] AS [v]

) AS [t] ON [m].[Id] = [t].[MangaId]

    ORDER BY CASE
        WHEN [t].[Id] IS NULL THEN CAST(0 AS bigint)
        ELSE [t].[TotalCount]
    END DESC, [m].[Id] DESC
    OFFSET @__p_0 ROWS FETCH NEXT @__p_1 ROWS ONLY
) AS [t0]
INNER JOIN (

    FROM [MangaTag] AS [m0]
    INNER JOIN (

) AS [t1] ON [t0].[Id] = [t1].[MangaId]

    ELSE CAST(0 AS bit)
END, [t2].[Id], [t2].[MangaId], [t2].[Index], [t2].[Title], [t2].[CreateDate], CASE
    WHEN [t3].[Id] IS NULL THEN CAST(1 AS bit)
    ELSE CAST(0 AS bit)
END, [t3].[Id], [t3].[DisplayName], [t3].[AvatarThumbnail]
FROM (
    SELECT [r].[Id], [r].[Rating], [r].[ToChapterId], [r].[ToMangaId], [r].[ToUserId], [r].[UserId]
    FROM [Rating] AS [r]
    WHERE ([r].[IdUserDelete] IS NULL OR [r].[IdUserDelete] LIKE N'') AND [r].[DeleteDate] IS NULL AND [r].[ToMangaId] = @__request_MangaId_0 AND [r].[UserId] = @__targetId_1
    ORDER BY [r].[Rating]
    OFFSET @__p_2 ROWS FETCH NEXT @__p_3 ROWS ONLY
) AS [t]
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT [u].[Id], [u].[DisplayName]
    FROM [Users] AS [u]
    WHERE ([u].[IdUserDelete] IS NULL OR [u].[IdUserDelete] LIKE N'') AND [u].[DeleteDate] IS NULL
) AS [t0] ON [t].[UserId] = [t0].[Id]
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT [m].[Id], [m].[Countries], [m].[Description], [m].[MangaBackground], [m].[MangaThumbnail], [m].[Name], [m].[Season], [m].[Status]
    FROM [Manga] AS [m]
    WHERE ([m].[IdUserDelete] IS NULL OR [m].[IdUserDelete] LIKE N'') AND [m].[DeleteDate] IS NULL
) AS [t1] ON [t].[ToMangaId] = [t1].[Id]
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT [c].[Id], [c].[CreateDate], [c].[Index], [c].[MangaId], [c].[Title]
    FROM [Chapter] AS [c]
    WHERE ([c].[IdUserDelete] IS NULL OR [c].[IdUserDelete] LIKE N'') AND [c].[DeleteDate] IS NULL
) AS [t2] ON [t].[ToChapterId] = [t2].[Id]
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT [u0].[Id], [u0].[AvatarThumbnail], [u0].[DisplayName]
    FROM [Users] AS [u0]
    WHERE ([u0].[IdUserDelete] IS NULL OR [u0].[IdUserDelete] LIKE N'') AND [u0].[DeleteDate] IS NULL
) AS [t3] ON [t].[ToUserId] = [t3].[Id]
ORDER BY [t].[Rating]
